reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.text: We were due to fly Nairobi to Zanzibar with another operator, but were let down when they cancelled the flight at short notice. We got a taxi across to Wilson airport where the SafariLink team rapidly ticketed us, checked us in and walked us through customs/immigration to get us onto their flight with less than 10 mins to spare. Without exception the team were helpful, courteous and kind to us - thank you!
reviews.author: Bartridge

reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text: My experience with Safarilink staff i.e. KSM to NBI was nightmarish. My takeaway - if you can afford it just fly Jambo Jet instead. Never again!
reviews.author: Kami

reviews.title: Correction of Brandons evaluation
reviews.text: I fly on Safari Link several times a year and take an average of 15 others with me each time. To correct the erroneous review from previous traveler Brandon. It is well documented that if you are flying to Zanzibar from the Maasai Mara you will need a yellow fever vaccine to enter the country. I am checked every time I go. It is VERY WELL documented and that he holds Safari Link responsible for his lack of knowledge is very self serving. Safari Link is a great company. they are tricky to navigate the reservation process ahead of time but when we are at Wilson, everyone is extremely helpful.
reviews.author: Safaris and moore

reviews.title: **Travel Advisory **
reviews.text: ** Travel Advisory ** Will never fly Safari Link again! We arrived for our flight on time and began the check in process. We were told that we needed a yellow fever shot. We were told it needs to be a week in advance and we would have to reschedule our flight. This is the first time we heard of this. My wife verified that all the information emailed about our flight only listed covid as a requirement and when we told the staff they said it's our responsibility to know we need it. After being turned away a gentleman in a safarilink uniform pulled us aside and said he could get us the yellow fever cards and have them back dated so we could make our flight. My wife originally being from kenya knows some of the shady dealings that goes on agreed to give it a try since we were desperate to fly into Tanzania for our trip. After paying 30 american dollars a piece. We received the cards with official stamps of kenya on them (how corrupt?) on time but we were then told by safarilink staff that issue tickets that our baby ( 14months) needs a shot and they couldn't get us a card for her (which is not true because children under 2 don't need it. We were told to go down to the medical center at the Wilson airport. Upon arrival they stated they won't open the container for the shots unless we found 7 other children needing a shot. They feared the remaining shots would expire before being used. By this time we had missed our flight. We ubered all the way Jkia airport looking for the shot for our baby only find out that she didn't need i. We called safarilink with this information and they confirmed the baby indeed doesn't need this. They said they look into this so it doesn't happen again but we had to pay hundreds to re-book as they look into this. Had to pay for an unexpected hotel rooms with family. Upon entering Tanzania the following day after the mess we dealed with and safari link refusing to help us in anyway, Tanzanian immigration didn't even ask for any yellow fever cards nor Covid cards???!! down at the airport, safarilink was just squeezing money out of us!
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: May be cheap with fake offers
reviews.text: We checked in the airline for Nairobi today from Zanzibar and it was of a lifetime disappointment. The staff was very rude and could not offer an explanation why we had to pay extra USD 52. Atleast as a customer,simple explanation was needed why we had to pay more money yet it was a carry on luggage
reviews.author: Victor O

reviews.title: Good flights and ran to time
reviews.text: Good flights that run to time, they operate a bit like a bus so you may have a couple of take offs and landings en-route to your final destination (make sure you get off at the right stop!)
reviews.author: Charlie L

reviews.title: Mr. Sammy Ojowi
reviews.text: My experience with Safarilink is on another level, the staff are friendly and very professional. Safety is their priority
reviews.author: sammy ojowi

reviews.title: Amazing airline
reviews.text: We were ferried around Kenya by the excellent pilots from Safarilink and could not have asked for smoother or more punctual flights.
reviews.author: Ann M

reviews.title: A very convenient way to fly from Nairobi to Diani and other places
reviews.text: The flight was on time and smooth, despite a lot of clouds near the coastal area. A well run and reliable airline for local travel. The only complaint I have is that the air conditioning was inadequate. It was very hot both in Nbo and at the coast.
reviews.author: CossyWombat

reviews.title: Safari link review
reviews.text: We had Stanley as driver through Safari Link and I could listen to that beauty all day, genuine dude with a heart of gold who got us where we needed safe and in good time if you ever travel with safari link make sure to ask for Stan the Man!!!!!
reviews.author: James s

reviews.title: Thank You Safarilink!
reviews.text: We took Safarilink from Nairobi to Amboselli, Amboseli to Laikipia, Lakipia to Maasai Mara, and from Maasai Mara back to Nairobi. All flights were on time and comfortable. The pilots were terrific and made the flights fun. They also pointed out the best stops for restrooms since some of our flights had several stops. You saved us a lot of time. I would definitely book Safarilink in the future.
reviews.author: fiamma11

reviews.title: Efficient
reviews.text: We flew 4 legs with this airline and experienced their Cessna Caravans and de Havilland Dash 8 aircraft. On the leg from Nairobi to Ngerende we were the fifth stop, but on most trips we only made one or two stops. They are very efficient! The flight attendant or copilot serves as the gate agent at the smaller airstrips and the baggage handler flies along in the bigger planes. Even on the Cessna Caravan flights there was cabin service. They passed out bottles of water and passed around a container full of hard candy. They may arrive a little late because of an extra stop, but they always left exactly on time.
reviews.author: phat_dawg_21

reviews.title: Five flights all excellent.... plus help with a donation of goods
reviews.text: Just returned from a two week trip to Kenya where we utilized Safarilink for five different legs of travel between safari camps and diani beach. All the flights were excellent, on time and made check-in as easy as possible. Tracking luggage was also easy and recovering the luggage after a trip was seamless. We also got a lot of help from the administrative staff in helping to make a donation of school supplies to schools in the Lewa area through a program called Pack for a Purpose, for which Safarilink is a partner. They delivered several bags of donated goods without any additional cost, and we really appreciate their help. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: taxman53

reviews.title: Multiple internal flights
reviews.text: We took a number of flights with SafariLink between various national parks in Kenya and a flight from Arusha to Wilson. The flights were mainly on time, some were on the larger Dash-8 planes, but the most fun was on the Cessna Caravan flights. Service was good and the pilots/staff were polite and friendly, happy to use them again
reviews.author: Rick K

reviews.title: Very horrible airline
reviews.text: Horrible customer service, don't dare turn up even a second late for your flight. No calls no nothing.
reviews.author: Kiki

reviews.title: Smooth flights and process, and very accomodating
reviews.text: We had a total of six flights on SafariLink airlines during our two weeks in Kenya (Nairobi - Amboseli, Amboseli - Ol Pajeta, Ol Pajeta - Maasai Mara, Maasai Mara - Nairobi, Nairobi - Diani Beach, Mombasa - Nairobi), and all were very smooth from all standpoints; checkin, boarding, flight, landing, and overall customer service. We were a group of 27 travelers, and SafariLink did all they could to accommodate us. They even changed plane options and rerouted our original itinerary in one case to make our experience easier and better. The planes were clean and well maintained, and the staff were courteous and friendly. SafariLink helped make our experience in Kenya one to remember... in a GREAT way!
reviews.author: POSitiveBrett

reviews.title: A very convenient local airline in Kenya, especially for game parks
reviews.text: Flying to the Mara is a very convenient way to get to the many wonderful camps. I stayed at Ishara, a relatively new camp, and I have to say the best I have stayed in to date. The flight from Wilson to Olkiambo was nearly 2 hours late and coming back similar delays. The latter was not the airline's fault since thee airspace over Nbo was closed to commercial traffic for Madaraka day celebrations.
reviews.author: CossyWombat

reviews.title: Sort of an Adventure Tourism
reviews.text: It was sort of an adventure tourism activity than a means of transport. Safarilink has a dedicated terminal at WIL and the check in process was super quick. The security staff and the check in staff were very fast and efficient. Almost all passengers to catch various flights simply breezed through the processes. A noisy turbo prop taking off an airport which looked like a 3 wheeler stand in India with haphazardly parked tiny turboprops was a surreal experience. There was a single cabin crew and no wash room in the aircraft. A bottle of water was given to all passengers but no snacks. But that is OK for a 45 minute flight. The configuration of seats was exactly like those Isuzu buses we find in Kenya- two seats each on either side of the aisle and a long 5 seater in the last row. The safety guidelines like removing the seat cushion and using the same as a life jacket in case of a crisis sounded outlandish though realistic. It altogether was an interesting flight but we feel a trace of risk while we are at it. Good option as an one off experience.
reviews.author: Anand G

reviews.title: Unreasonable rules
reviews.text: Pathetic, I reached the airport 15 minutes before departure time. A bit later than their recommended time, but still reasonable for a local flight. They wouldn't let me board saying I was late, argued with the attendant for 10 minutes while the plane was still there would have boarded the flight in those 10 minutes, 15 minutes prior to departure any other reasonable local flight in Kenya would have allowed for boarding. My guess is they sold the ticket to someone else.
reviews.author: Mukund M

reviews.title: The worst flight ever if I could I would give it a 0
reviews.text: There’s corona and almost all airlines flights are flexible . Kenya being Kenya Safarilink being part of if it . I have travelled with Qatar Emirates,but I have never had of policy so called amendments of date they charge 3000 ksh plus the extra amendment of my ticked . The flight is not fully booked , I would mind paying my flight diff but adding extra free to which I don’t know what’s catering for its not that I’ll be upgraded to business or the sits is any difference you only get a bottle of mini water and a sum of 90$ . Will I fly with this again never it’s just a whole system of people pretending to carter air hospitality. Mind you the stuff with the attitude.
reviews.author: Jfisher

reviews.title: Ruined my Makeup equipment
reviews.text: I was traveling from Diani to Nairobi for a visit and when I arrived in Nairobi my Makeup equipments were ruined. It froze in the air because during the flight Luggage compartment was unpressurized. I do not recommend this flight especially for the ladies who have makeup stuff.
reviews.author: Candy

reviews.title: Can  Safarilink
reviews.text: Flight was on time both ways. Nice seats on the plane, good leg room. Safarilink was recommended to me by a friend and after flying with them I'd be happy to fly with them again.
reviews.author: Hannah

reviews.title: Safarilink is the Best!
reviews.text: We flew to Nanyuki for Christmas and the flight left early hence we made it for breakfast with our family and friends. Safarilink is a premier airline with a private lounge. The staff were very professional and friendly.
reviews.author: ckswara

reviews.title: Thanks for a perfect service
reviews.text: I flow with them from amboseli to Nairobi and from Nairobi to Masai Mara and their reservations department helped me with all the requests and options. Really amazing service. Thanks. Looking forward to fly with you again
reviews.author: jesuspsmadrid

reviews.title: One of the most reliable small airlines for local tarvel within Kenya
reviews.text: A very convenient way to get from my home in Diani to Nairobi (Wilson). This was small aircraft and was interesting, but normally they are larger aircraft. Good service and on time departure. Safarilink also have a courier type service to send small packages from/to Diani which I found very useful, having forgotten my driving licence in Diani
reviews.author: John C

reviews.title: A very good small airline
reviews.text: We were ready to take off when the pilot turned us around to change planes when he wasn't happy with the controls- definitely not a problem with me. When we had a fresh aircraft, the 40 min flight was comfortable and un-eventful on our Nairobi to the Maasai Mara trip. Our return flight a week later was also fine.
reviews.author: DrillerBurlington

reviews.title: A Wonderful Airline with Great Customer Service
reviews.text: We flew with SL from Wison Airport to Maasai. We also had tickets to fly from Wilson to Zanzibar. Unfortunately, SL could not perform the Zanzibar flights (return) and so arranged for alternative flights with Precision Air. This meant travelling from Nairobi International which could have caused problems with transferring and stored luggage etc. Well, SL could not have been more helpful. I was so overwhelmed by the service. On arriving back from Maasai, they provided lunch. They then arranged for us to be transferred to Nairobi International. Our excess luggage stored at Wilson remained there. When we got back to Nairobi, they had the luggage transported to our hotel. Honestly, the whole experience was just first class. One member of staff, Jackie, was just excellent. Constantly in contact, so quick to respond etc. An absolute dream.
reviews.author: olafjsy

reviews.title: on time for all 5 short flights we had scheduled
reviews.text: We took 5 short flights on Safarilink while visiting 4 locations in Kenya. All flights were on time and satisfactory. Small planes, landing sometimes on airstrips rather than airports.
reviews.author: peggy s

reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: We had a great experience on Safarilink. We took 4 flights over a course of 8 days, all were on time and the pilots provided a great flying experience. The main airport, Wilson, is easy to navigate. Check in was a breeze with no issues. Soft sided bags are required since the plane is small with a small cargo area. We stored two large bags at the airport for 8 days while on safari with no issues. The planes are small so there isn't a ton of room; however, that is to be expected given the airports in the national park.
reviews.author: DreamaG

reviews.title: A tight fit!
reviews.text: The planes used are compact and when full make movement on and off the plane a challenge for some. The staff are very efficient and helpful. Baggage is limited weight wise (15kg) and soft bags are advised.
reviews.author: Beverley B

reviews.title: A very convenient flight
reviews.text: We use Safarilink several times a year from Vipingo to Wilson and back. The service is almost always on schedule. The staff are pleasant and helpful. The Terminal / Cafe in Wilson is good. The -8 aircraft are comfortable and clean. This airline is highly recommended.
reviews.author: BeechBaron55

reviews.title: Sleeping Pilot!
reviews.text: I love to fly! It is in my blood! I come from a family of pilots. I took flying lessons myself. Which is why...when on an airplane...I notice everything the pilot does or doesn't do. But in this case, two of my group members noticed what one of the pilots wasn't doing! He was sleeping!! On one of my flights to the Fairmont Mara Safari Club in Kenya, one of the pilots kept falling asleep! When it got bumpy, he would wake up! He did this all the way to the Mara Safari Club. I wasn't worried because the other pilot was flying the plane. But...it really scared my two group members! I had a group of 12 on that flight. When we landed I told my group members to go and enjoy the cold drinks that were waiting for them. I went and talked to the pilots. I was not happy!! I have not used this airline since! I use their competitor now.
reviews.author: Safarigirl

reviews.title: Glad we took Safarilink - It was safe, fast and entertaining
reviews.text: So glad we took Safarilink. We originally considered driving from Nairobi to the Mara. The Wilson airport is very comfortable, the Safarilink team organizes their flights and customers very well and the pilot and co-pilot were professional and made us feel safe and allowed us to get to the Mara in less than an hour in what would have been a bumpy six-hour (plus) drive. Best of all, we liked looking out the windows to see animals roaming and the beautiful and diverse terrain of Kenya.
reviews.author: EGRap

reviews.title: Bush Travel - Wilson - Lewa - Loisaba - Wilson
reviews.text: Rainy day, bumpy, cloudy, turbulent but the pilots were great and such good sports. Fast and easy check-in. Good customer service.
reviews.author: raychepkonga

reviews.title: Return Home
reviews.text: Smooth flight from Diani to NBO despite a cloudy day all through. The dash 8 300 series was amazing.
reviews.author: raychepkonga

reviews.title: Simple,efficient,good
reviews.text: This small airlines which connect safari sites and airports is doing very efficiently the job. We had twice a nice pilot , Henri , doing quietly and very nicely his job. As sleek as possible flight .
reviews.author: jehudam2017

reviews.title: not professional not reliable
reviews.text: I was in need to change my ticket,, but nobody at the local office s number provided was available. When I tried to recall my booking on the Safarilink website I got a message: "the reservation is not active and cannot be found" Therefore the time available in the policy to make any free change withun the 24 hours expired I had to pay the equivalent of 55 US$ to change my flight.
reviews.author: miky

reviews.title: Great airline
reviews.text: aircraft in great condition, well maintained. seating was comfortable with good leg room. great captain and safety briefing.
reviews.author: wiley-nt

reviews.title: A Fantastic Small Air Service
reviews.text: We recently flew from Wilson Airport to Ol Seki Airstrip in Masai Mara. Ground staff were excellent and very helpful. You are only allowed to carry 15 Kg which also includes hand luggage. Our extra luggage was stored for us at Wilson Airport free of charge. The single propellor Cessana plane flew at a low height that allowed you to see plains below. We could see Zebras and antelopes below. The landing on a dirt airstrip was relatively smooth. All our anxities of flying in a small aircraft was put to rest by the competent pilot and his first officer. Flying from Kenya to Zanzibar was made smooth and easy by Safarilink ground staff who accompanied us through Immigration and brought our stored luggage to the plane for our Tanzania flight
reviews.author: Travelerglasgow

reviews.title: Great Flights
reviews.text: We used Safarilink from Nairobi Wilson to Samuru then onto Masai Mara and finally to Zanzibar via Wilson. Every flight was on-time or earlier and gave us a great experience added to pout Safari Adventures.
reviews.author: PaulBee8

reviews.title: Excellent service from Nairobi to Diani (Ukunda)
reviews.text: A very convenient way to come from Nairobi to Diani Beach. The flight takes about one hour and the plane was comfortable and the in flight service fine.
reviews.author: John C

reviews.title: Short flight
reviews.text: Stunning views of the Mara on this small 16 seater on the way to Wilson. Perfect for the 1 hour flight but I wonder what we missed by flying rather than driving.......?!
reviews.author: Herefordnomads

reviews.title: Domestic tourism
reviews.text: Hello ,I highly recommend safari link for domestic tourism frights they are very reliable and the crew are awesome,they always keep on time my groups have used them for over 5 years now and it’s always a plus ,the prices are also pocket friendly and the best of all they safety is there first priority.
reviews.author: Nick Njuguna

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: Staff was so helpful, during the flight and in the office at the airport. Helped me with everything and made sure I got along. Thank you
reviews.author: Michal y

reviews.title: Very affordable
reviews.text: The best part of it was that it was convenient and quick.It had great legroom the seats were just comfy
reviews.author: _monix_Kinyanjui

reviews.title: A Highlight!
reviews.text: This is truly one of the highlights of our trip. Flying above the clouds toward Kilimanjaro. The flight took off on time, was smooth and convenient. I loved it!
reviews.author: J. Miller

reviews.title: Convenient flight
reviews.text: Safarilink provide a very convenient flight afternoon from and to Nairobi Wilson every day serving Diani/Ukunda on Kenya’s south coast and then Vipingo Ridge on the north coast. For those who prefer to avoid both Nairobi’s Jomo Kenyatta International Airport and Mombasa’s Moi international Airport, this Safarilink Flight is highly recommend. The baggage allowance is reasonable at 20kgs. The Safarilink Wilson Airport lounge has plenty of seating with a coffee and snack bar, plus the staff are very helpful. The quaint little airport lounge at Ukunda and the palm frond thatch shack at Vipingo add to the charm of a bygone era. The aircraft used is a Bombadier Dash-8, a comfortable twin engines turbo prop. The flight is usually very punctual.
reviews.author: BeechBaron55

reviews.title: Nairobi to The Mara
reviews.text: We flew with a few people into The Mara...for the most part the trip was uneventful and quite quick an convenient.
reviews.author: martydiamond

reviews.title: Most honest and caring 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
reviews.text: We used SafariLink Airlines to get us around Kenya for 4 different flights. On one of these I left my iPad. I didn’t know I had, as we were on safari and I hadn’t looked for it. When I had WiFi again I saw I had multiple emails from SafariLink who’d opened my tablet and tracked me down!! They held my tablet for a week until I was back in Nairobi, but I was SO impressed they’d bothered! Also, when my friends bags were grossly overweight for one flight, they supplied a SafariLink bag for her to store her excess baggage until our return to Nairobi!! The flights were stunning flying over giraffe and hippo, always felt safe in the hands of their pilots. With the thermals it can be bumpy, but I was never nervous. Wish all the airlines I fly with were as accommodating, professional and with a genuine heart as SAFARILINK. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
reviews.author: Karen Dotrice

reviews.title: How to see Kenya
reviews.text: We flew from Wilson to Ukunda (Diani beach) in December and back after the new year. Luggage is limited to 15Kg per person in soft luggage but this is no problem. Security is very high and you have to identify your luggage whilst it is waiting on the apron, then you watch it being loaded. Staff on the ground and in the air are friendly, efficient and welcoming. The small planes mean that you can access some really special wild places, with small, dirt landing strips. Great fun.
reviews.author: Gill W
